content: {"reasoning":"The retroactive authorization window is closed, and Meridian does not offer peer-to-peer review; the valid codes and correct billing order provide no basis for claim correction. CO-197 permits a formal medical-necessity appeal, which has not yet been attempted and led to payment in 9 of 23 similar claims. Appeal is the remaining viable payer action; the authorization denial does not itself establish patient liability, so billing the patient or writing off now would be premature.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
